NATO jets intercepted and shot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace, marking a significant escalation as the alliance warns that continued Russian strikes could galvanize further international support for Ukraine [NATO jets down drone](https://news.google.?oc=5). This event coincides with a global trend of increasing counter-drone activity; the British Army deployed the Halo Shield drone detection system after rapid trials, and DroneShield collaborated with AIM Defence to integrate high-power laser technology into its counter-drone architecture [British Army rolls out Halo Shield](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBwbmcyZEM1VTNzMEFjeWgzX2N5dGFPZXNFRzJleGg5VGtfaWhMWnFNbXJXN2d1c0NSWlJ2Um85cmktTUdhS29ZLV94T1praUFfdFpjZm5RYzM5M0NuNnAtRHB4U1otT01uRUpz?oc=5), [DroneShield and AIM Defence Collaborate](https://www.suasnews.com/2026/09/15/droneshield-and-aim-defence-collaborate-on-directed-energy-in-counter-drone-architecture/).

Autonomous vehicle operations are expanding globally. Waymo announced plans to launch fully driverless taxi services in Tokyo by 2027 with up to 100 vehicles [Waymo Accelerates Global Robotaxi Expansion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQQ1JfUlNwRFh4SnFxU0VYVjZ3V0huZVdfXzRoYnNLUnFqVEZfbWZQNGRhQS1Wejc1OGwzeV84cWFCWEJuMjB0NU5reHJ1czFMbFFkRC1UTmVsRXhMVHRoMkFwdkhJNlIzdm1wM0FHUVRiVmhwQmotSVBYWmpDSlVVeDNIYlRDdXJ0UGN6YzJPY2wzanhRcUlFdVg0dTVma1NiVDZv?oc=5). Additionally, the Federal Communications Commission issued a waiver enabling the Department of Transportation to test cellular networks for drones to gather airborne coverage data for safety services and command and control [FCC Clears Nationwide Test](https://dronelife.com/2026/09/15/fcc-cellular-networks-for-drones-testing/).

In Advanced Air Mobility, Joby Aviation conducted demonstrations in Arizona and announced upcoming flights in Wichita [Arizona Lawmakers Continue Advanced Air Mobility Push](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPY3VQVkFxZUZfVVEzTVBuLTlrTUN0ckRBSmhGSk1wX1dlcm9sZjZaeGpiY0NvSTVvTXEwSjFOM011WS1Xb1FsV0EteEZpZnhSMDVKRWhQMGktb19feUozMklnMDJzYThVTXVKRWx4Um1keDVSTzdENEF1MTllTXNEZ0xmMlRPcUF4MWNIOHNKMlNiWEc5WDdwRFJPS2FHd0FMTlo2bHlwcDlzZUdFc0FYcndNMUMwYXE1VHc?oc=5). Simultaneously, the Federal Aviation Administration is launching Phase 2 of its BEYOND drone program with plans to double its size by adding up to 8 participants [Drones Could Be Buzzing Across America's Skies](https://www.aol.com/articles/drones-could-buzzing-across-americas-203759000.html).
